GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT: T6 must create a reusable smoke test script (not just procedural verification). Add to acceptance criteria:

- [ ] tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke.sh created and executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke.sh
- [ ] .test-index entry added mapping smoke test to the source skill file used in the test
  Verify: grep -q 'test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke' .test-index
- [ ] Smoke test script exits 0 when bash block runs successfully (CI-repeatable)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke.sh

Rationale: DD3 requires 'verifiable in ticket system' which implies repeatability. The SC3 hook and future CI regression checks need a CI-runnable script, not one-time manual verification.
